title: IH 10 East and Loop 1604

rows.label: Location
rows.text: The property is located at the northwest corner of the intersection of IH 10 East and Loop 1604 in San Antonio, Texas.

rows.label: Utilities
rows.note: Prospective buyers should retain an independent engineer to verify the location, accessibility, and available capacity of all utilities.

rows.label: Zoning
rows.text: C-3, Commercial, City of San Antonio
rows.note: Prospective buyers should verify the zoning and permitted uses for this property with the appropriate governing authority.

rows.label: Flood Plain
rows.text: The Federal Emergency Management Agency maps do not appear to indicate any floodplain on the site.

rows.label: Traffic Count
rows.text: Most recent (2024) Texas State Highway Department traffic count map indicates 40,955 vehicles per day on Loop 1604, just north of the property and 68,517 vehicles per day on IH 10, west of the property.

rows.label: Demographics
rows.note: Source: U.S. Bureau of the Census, 2020 Census of Population and Housing. ESRI forecasts for 2026.

rows.label: Potential Uses
rows.text: Convenience Store, Restaurant, Car Wash, Bank, and other commercial uses

qa_notes: SIZE MISMATCH: PDF says '1.34 +/- Acres' (spec page and the p5/p6 aerial headers '1.34+/-Acres'); Prismic size_label is '1.32 acres' / acres 1.32.

IMAGE DEFECT: the Location Map (p3) and Area Map (p4) are Google My Maps screenshots with a visible Windows 'Activate Windows / Go to Settings to activate Windows' watermark in the lower right. These should be re-captured before the package goes to buyers.

p7 is a Pape-Dawson exhibit titled 'BILL MILLER 1604 & I-10 ... AERIAL MAP' — the site appears to be (or have been) planned for a Bill Miller; confirm the exhibit is intended for the marketing package.

Demographic Overview uses a different, shorter ESRI format than the other packages (dated March 26, 2026, 2026 estimates only, no 2020 Census or 5-year projection, no race/ethnicity or income-bracket sections). Its final 'Median Household Income' row sits under no section heading; it is transcribed as a section with an empty heading.
Demographic Overview housing tenure does not total 100% (Owner-Occupied + Renter-Occupied = 99% / 96% / 96% at 1 / 3 / 5 miles) — presumably vacant units; values kept as printed.
Spec-page Demographics table (Population 2026 Estimate and Median Household Income at 1/3/5 miles) matches the Demographic Overview exactly.
Title: cover reads 'IH 10 EAST AND LOOP 1604'; Prismic title is 'IH 10 East at Loop 1604' ('and' vs 'at'); Demographic Overview heading is 'IH 10 at LOOP 1604'.
No Frontage, Topography or Easements rows in this package; Utilities has no introductory sentence.
Transaction: PDF never says For Sale or For Lease ('Pricing: Contact Broker'); 'For Sale' used per schema default. Prismic total_price 'Contact Broker' matches.
Zoning 'C-3, Commercial, City of San Antonio' matches Prismic 'C-3 Commercial, City of San Antonio' (punctuation only). Prismic highlights match the three PDF comments verbatim.
